_comment: Government rules as dated data. A rule change is a new entry with a later effective_from; old entries are never edited. Loaded by `manage.py seed_demo` (idempotent).

versions.title: EPF: 12% + 12%, wage ceiling ₹15,000
versions.note: EPF & MP Act. Wage ceiling ₹15,000 since Sep 2014.

versions.title: ESI: 0.75% + 3.25% when gross ≤ ₹21,000
versions.note: Rates revised 1 Jul 2019; ceiling ₹21,000 since 1 Jan 2017.

versions.title: ESI: contribution period coverage and employee daily wage exemption
versions.note: ESI Central Rules 2, 50 and 52. The ₹176 employee exemption was effective 6 Sep 2019. This engine picks rules on the first day of the pay month.

versions.title: Karnataka PT: ₹200 when gross ≥ ₹25,000
versions.note: Simplified H-02 rule (Karnataka). Add a new version with a later start date to change it.

versions.title: New regime FY 2025-26 (no tax up to ₹12 lakh)
versions.note: Finance Act 2025: slabs of ₹4 lakh, standard deduction ₹75,000, 87A rebate up to ₹60,000 with marginal relief, 4% cess.

versions.title: Labour Codes: excluded pay above 50% counts as wages
versions.note: Code on Wages / Code on Social Security, in force 21 Nov 2025. Applies from December 2025 payroll (rules are read as of the 1st of the month).

versions.title: Telangana PT: ₹150 above ₹15,000, ₹200 above ₹20,000
versions.note: Telangana professional tax on monthly gross pay. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. Sources: https://www.zoho.com/in/payroll/academy/payroll-laws/telangana/professional-tax.html ; https://cleartax.in/s/professional-tax-telangana ; https://www.greythr.com/wiki/acts/professional-tax-telangana

versions.title: Andhra Pradesh PT: ₹150 above ₹15,000, ₹200 above ₹20,000
versions.note: Andhra Pradesh professional tax on monthly gross pay. One source adds ₹300 in March; the others do not, so it is not included. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. Sources: https://cleartax.in/s/professional-tax-andhra-pradesh ; https://www.zoho.com/in/payroll/academy/payroll-laws/andhra-pradesh/professional-tax.html ; https://www.greythr.com/wiki/acts/professional-tax-andhra-pradesh

versions.title: Gujarat PT: ₹200 above ₹12,000
versions.note: Gujarat professional tax on monthly gross pay. Revised from 24 May 2022 per one source. Sources differ on exactly ₹12,000; it is taken as exempt. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. No due day: the sources disagree, so add 'due_day_next_month' before a month with this rule is finalised. Sources: https://factohr.com/professional-tax/gujarat/ ; https://www.greythr.com/wiki/acts/professional-tax-gujarat/ ; https://cleartax.in/s/professional-tax-gujarat

versions.title: Assam PT: ₹180 above ₹15,000, ₹208 from ₹25,000
versions.note: Assam professional tax on monthly gross pay. The April 2025 revision as reported. The state's 2014 schedule puts exactly ₹15,000 in the ₹180 slab. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. Sources: https://cleartax.in/s/professional-tax-assam ; https://greythr.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/1060000142757-what-are-the-revised-professional-tax-pt-slabs-applicable-in-assam-from-april-2025- ; https://tax.assam.gov.in/AssamTimsInfo/content/professional_tax.html

versions.title: Odisha PT: ₹125 above ₹13,304, ₹200 above ₹25,000 (₹300 in February)
versions.note: Odisha professional tax on monthly gross pay. One source says Odisha stops PT from 1 April 2026; not confirmed, so not added. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. No due day: the sources disagree, so add 'due_day_next_month' before a month with this rule is finalised. Sources: https://cleartax.in/s/professional-tax-odisha ; https://factohr.com/professional-tax/odisha/ ; https://odishatax.gov.in/professional_tax.php

versions.title: Sikkim PT: ₹125 above ₹20,000, ₹150 above ₹30,000, ₹200 above ₹40,000
versions.note: Sikkim professional tax on monthly gross pay. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. No due day: the sources disagree, so add 'due_day_next_month' before a month with this rule is finalised. Sources: https://www.zoho.com/in/payroll/academy/payroll-laws/sikkim/professional-tax.html ; https://factohr.com/professional-tax/sikkim/ ; https://www.startupgrantsindia.com/calculators/operations/professional-tax/sikkim

versions.title: Tripura PT: ₹150 above ₹7,500, ₹208 above ₹15,000
versions.note: Tripura professional tax on monthly gross pay. Per the Tripura Gazette notification of 25 July 2018 as reported. Sources word the ₹7,500 boundary differently; ₹7,500 is taken as exempt. From secondary sources (payroll and tax guides), not the state's own notification: verify before relying on it. No due day: the sources disagree, so add 'due_day_next_month' before a month with this rule is finalised. Sources: https://www.zoho.com/in/payroll/academy/payroll-laws/tripura/professional-tax.html ; https://www.startupgrantsindia.com/calculators/operations/professional-tax/tripura ; https://calcguru.in/?p=728
